text:
dana: Hey folks — quick Q. My partner is giving birth overseas while on deployment and I need to travel there. What's Redwood's policy for paternity/primary caregiver leave when the birth happens abroad? Also need to ship a laptop and arrange temporary remote work approval.

emily: Congrats, Dana. For births abroad we treat parental leave the same as domestic: file the leave request at https://redwood.hr/leave and upload the birth certificate or official hospital discharge when available. Primary caregiver paid leave applies if you are the documented primary caregiver. For travel, submit travel receipts for reimbursement under "Parental travel" — see https://redwood.hr/expenses.

dana: Do I need any visa/immigration paperwork to qualify? The birth certificate will be local and later registered; it might take a few weeks.

emily: You can submit a provisional claim with hospital paperwork and service member deployment orders. Payroll will accept provisional docs and process STD/top-up pending final birth record. If the official certificate arrives later, upload it to the claim.

payroll-bot: Automated: STD claim type `INTL-BABY` accepted with provisional docs. Processing of payroll top-up occurs after claim approval; expect update within two payroll cycles. Please ensure bank details are up to date.

dana: Remote work: I'll need approval to work from the partner's country for ~3 weeks post-birth. Any restrictions?

emily: International remote work needs manager sign-off and People Ops approval due to tax/compliance. Submit the Remote Work Abroad form: https://redwood.hr/remote with travel dates, country, and reason (parental support). We'll run a quick review; approvals typically within 3 business days. If country has export control or sanction flags, approval may be denied.

dana: Got it. Laptop: can I ship a company laptop to their location for a month?

facilities: Shipping company equipment internationally requires an international-shipment ticket: https://redwood.tools/facilities choose `international-shipment`. Include return ETA and confirmation you will not leave the device unattended. Facilities will confirm insurance and customs steps. If device stays >90 days, IT and Security need to review.

dana: Thanks. If I end up taking intermittent leave (split weeks) how does that affect pay and benefits?

emily: Intermittent leave is supported; however, STD/top-up payments are prorated based on days off. Benefits remain active during paid leave. For payroll sequencing, log intermittent days in the leave form and attach partial-day approvals from your manager. Payroll will show pro-rated STD payments.

mike: Heads-up: if you're on remote overseas, check oncall overlap for your timezone. I can take overflow during your travel window.

dana: Appreciate it. Filing leave and remote form now, and opening a facilities ticket for shipping. Will upload hospital docs as soon as I have them.

emily: Ping me if you want a benefits/ payroll sync call. We'll prioritize the remote review given the travel dates. Safe travels and congrats! :heart:
